subject: Probe dataset custody checklist + final MAP milestones
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@vortolabs.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Monroe <leah.monroe@vortolabs.com>; Vorto Labs Security <security@vortolabs.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset exchange – custody and usage questions

Camila —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The Vorto team is ready to move to a short pilot but we need to lock the MAP and a simple custody checklist for the probe dataset and prompt pack. Main asks from our side:

- Clear data handling constraints (never persisted outside the sandbox; ephemeral tokens only)
- Retention / takedown timeline (we need a 30-day post-pilot destruction window)
- A minimal access ledger for people who will touch the data

Can you share a MAP draft and a sample manifest for the dataset so our security folks can triage? Would be great if we can close this week — target pilot kickoff 7/6.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Head of ML Ops | Vorto Labs
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@vortolabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset exchange – custody and usage questions

Samir —

Thanks — attached are: 1) a one-page MAP draft with milestone dates, 2) a sample manifest for the probe dataset (sanitized), and 3) a stub NDA that we prefilled for expediency. Highlights up front:

- Retention: Redwood will host the dataset in an ephemeral sandbox. By default we retain artifacts for 14 days after pilot close; we can extend to 30 days as requested.
- Custody: Access is limited to named engineers; we maintain an access ledger and can provide exports on request.
- Destruction: We will issue a signed takedown certificate when data is purged.

Next steps I propose:
1) Your security team reviews the manifest and returns any blocking items by end of Thurs (7/1).
2) We finalize MAP and countersign NDA by Mon 7/5 so pilot can start 7/6.

Attaching the files as stubs: vorto_MAP_draft_v1.pdf, probe_dataset_sample_manifest.csv, redwood_ndasigned_stub.pdf.

If Marissa / Ben — any legal or ops notes to add?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset exchange – custody and usage questions

On it — reading the MAP now. A couple quick internal flags:

- We should add a short clause in the MAP that explicitly prohibits extraction of samples for model training outside the pilot. Phrase as: "Prohibited uses: no extraction, no external training without express written consent."
- Confirm the access ledger export cadence (we usually produce weekly csvs; for this pilot propose providing the ledger snapshot at kickoff, midpoint, and takedown).
- For the 30-day retention ask we'll approve but add an audit note: customer can request immediate destruction upon written notice (we'll follow up with takedown certificate).

Ben — can you confirm if there's any additional redline on the manifest format?

-Marissa
VP, Product Operations
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset exchange – custody and usage questions

Quick note from ops/security: manifest looks good; two small asks for Vorto:

1) Replace real customer PII in the sample manifest with tokenized IDs — we will not accept raw PII in the sandbox.
2) Confirm that the prompt pack will be delivered with a hash manifest so we can validate integrity on ingest.

If Vorto confirms those two points we can sign the MAP and proceed to countersign the NDA.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Ops
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@vortolabs.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Monroe <leah.monroe@vortolabs.com>; Vorto Labs Security <security@vortolabs.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Probe dataset exchange – custody and usage questions

Camila / team — thanks for the fast turn. We discussed internally and can confirm:

- We'll scrub PII and replace with token IDs before delivery.
- Prompt pack will be delivered with SHA256 manifest (hashes included).
- Security will review the manifest tonight; expect sign-off by EOD Monday 7/5.

Agreed milestones now:
- 7/5: MAP countersigned / NDA countersigned
- 7/6: Dataset & prompt pack ingest into Redwood ephemeral sandbox (pilot kickoff)
- 7/20: Midpoint check (ledger snapshot)
- 8/4: Pilot close; dataset takedown begins (30-day destruction window ends 9/3)

We appreciate the clear process and will return the signed MAP + hashed prompt pack early next week.

Best,
Samir
